title: Resolution of vectors; unit vectors
notes: **Scope.** Resolution of vectors; unit vectors — Vectors, Physics (class-11-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: resolution of vectors, unit vectors · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Vectors have magnitude + direction; a = aî + bĵ + c k̂. |a| = √(a²+b²+c²).
**Fact.** Dot: a·b = |a||b|cosθ = a₁b₁+a₂b₂+a₃b₃ (scalar; =0 ⟂). Cross: a×b (vector, ⟂ to both; |a×b| = |a||b|sinθ; area = ½|a×b|).
**Fact.** Triangle/parallelogram/polygon laws: vector sum is independent of order (commutative).
**Unit vectors.** one-line definition + one-line exam use.
